note: Independent audit after reading RFC 4271 Section 6.2, rfc/short/rfc4271.md, all seven tagged test units across rfc4271_open_framing_proof_test.go and rfc4271_open_errors_all_classes_proof_test.go, producing code (Session.handleOpen, admitOpen, validateOpenLocked, rejectOpenCapabilityError, validateOpenPeerAS, rejectOpenPeerAS, validateOpenIdentifier, runOpenValidator, validateCapabilityModes, validateAddPathFamilyModes, and incoming_candidate.go handlePendingCollision/readOpen/admitFrame), and all seven discrimination records. The combined ordinary and pending proof suites cover every OPEN decode and validation class: standard and RFC 9072 outer framing overruns (2/0), unsupported version 3 and 5 (2/1 with [0,4]), unacceptable hold time 1 and 2 (2/6 with [0,1]/[0,2]), 2-byte and 4-byte AS 0 and peer AS mismatch (2/2), unsupported optional parameter (2/4), malformed capability TLV (2/0), zero and iBGP-self BGP Identifier (2/3), plugin role-mismatch OPEN validation (2/11), and missing/refused required families, capabilities, and ADD-PATH families (2/7 with capability Data). All 17 validation error classes assert exact NOTIFICATION 2/<subcode>/<Data>, TCP io.EOF closure, and Idle or preserved incumbent OpenConfirm with cleared pending state. Conforming controls across standard/extended framing, hold time 0, eBGP shared identifier, 4-octet peer AS, and constrained capability/validator acceptance advance to OpenConfirm with KEEPALIVE on the ordinary rail and resolve pending collisions with Cease 6/7 instead of Error Code 2. All seven discrimination records mutate Error Code 2 or valid-OPEN/collision boundaries directly.
